integrity: The closed forms are derived analytically from the defining sphere equations. Numerical quadrature is used only as an independent diagnostic, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The formulas are proved only for the six unit balls centered at the regular-octahedron vertices \(\pm e_j/\sqrt2\).
No claim is made for the analogous spherical dodecahedron or for arbitrary six-ball intersections.
An unindexed historical closed form remains possible; the full text of Lustig (1985) was not accessible in the bounded source inspection.
title: Exact volume, surface area, and mean width of the spherical hexahedron
